profile.role_note: Glacio Resonance Skill burst DPS; power-crept by Hiyuki but still solid.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Solid Glacio DPS, but Hiyuki has taken her crown; pull only if you missed Hiyuki and specifically want a Glacio carry.

build.fast_path: Fast path: The Last Dance (or Static Mist) + 5-piece Frosty Resolve in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Sentry Construct in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Glacio DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and 120-125% Energy Regen so her Liberation is up every rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: The Last Dance
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit DMG substat, 12% ATK, and 48% Resonance Skill DMG on Intro/Liberation. ~20% better than Static Mist.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star; Crit Rate substat, ATK, and Energy Regen for smoother rotations.

ranked_weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
ranked_weapons.note: Universal ATK and All-Attribute DMG buffs.

ranked_weapons.name: Thunderbolt
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star pistol; ATK substat with Resonance Skill DMG passive. Battle-pass weapon.

ranked_weapons.name: Undying Flame
ranked_weapons.note: Usable 4-star; roughly equal to the other 4-star options at S5.

ranked_weapons.name: Relativistic Jet
ranked_weapons.note: Resonance Energy and ATK after skill; decent 4-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Romance in Farewell
ranked_weapons.note: Craftable F2P option; ATK buff on hitting enemies with Negative Statuses.

echo_sets.name: Frosty Resolve
echo_sets.note: Her tailor-made set: up to 48% Resonance Skill DMG and 45% Glacio DMG at max stacks, easily activated by her playstyle.

echo_sets.name: Freezing Frost
echo_sets.note: Consistent 40% Glacio DMG at 5 pieces; lacks the Resonance Skill DMG of Frosty Resolve.

echo_sets.name: Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: ATK% and Outro amplification for longer field time; less viable in quickswap teams.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit; Crit DMG is ideal with the signature's huge Crit DMG substat.
Glacio DMG on both; ATK% is a fine placeholder.

teams.name: Premium: Carlotta + Zhezhi + Shorekeeper

members.name: Carlotta
members.note: Glacio Resonance Skill burst DPS; wants her Liberation up every rotation.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Glacio DMG amplification and coordinated attacks; her Outro feeds Carlotta's Resonance Skill DMG.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit buffs and healing; detonates Stellarealm with her enhanced Intro at the end.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens to build Resonance Energy and deploy Stellarealm, Zhezhi builds Forte and Liberation for her Outro buff, then Carlotta enters: skill to build Forte, Heavy Attack burst, Liberation, and all shots within 10 seconds. Shorekeeper detonates Stellarealm to close.

teams.name: Alternative: Carlotta + Lynae + Mornye

members.name: Carlotta
members.note: Benefits heavily from Lynae and Mornye's All-Type DMG amplification.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Premier sub-DPS buffer: All-DMG and Liberation amplification.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: All-DMG amplification, Off-Tune Buildup Rate, and healing; pairs with Lynae for Tune Shifting effects.

teams.rotation: Mornye and Lynae stack their All-Type DMG amplification with Tune Breaks making up a significant portion of rotation damage, then Carlotta takes her burst window inside the buff coverage.

tier_badge.label: Excellent
tier_badge.note: Strong Glacio DPS; still excellent on Glacio teams. Beebom 3.7 rates her S, MMO Culture and Pocket Gamer A.
